integrity: The universal lower bound is proved analytically from the orderability definition; the finite verifier is only a stress test. The exact values at t=4,5 additionally rely on the cited published upper theorem. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The cycle construction yields only a t+3 lower bound and is not claimed asymptotically sharp. Exactness is asserted only for t=4 and t=5. A residual literature-overlap risk remains because semantic and exact-formula searches cannot guarantee discovery of every differently phrased or unindexed source.
title: Cycle lower bounds and two exact small orderable biclique Ramsey numbers
